description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dehemigama, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District (25/1200093)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land and property-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral maps, land title settlements, and property registrations across multiple districts (Polonnaruwa, Ratnapura, Galle), which directly fits the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
